tool_params.user_goal: Analyze the eight existing 1‑ns trajectories (apo and holo for p21860, q8iv63, q8nb16, q8wz42) to compute, for each system, (1) backbone RMSD over time, (2) per‑residue RMSF with a bar plot for residues 150–200 where they exist, (3) radius of gyration, and (4) for holo systems only, the COM distance between ATP and the catalytic pocket defined as protein atoms within 5 Å of ATP in frame 0. Generate per‑protein Cα DCCMs and, where both apo and holo cases are present, compute the DCCM difference; also produce DSSP time series for the entire protein and the 150–200 window. Compile overlay plots and statistical tables that compare these metrics across all four proteins. In the final report, retrieve literature on each protein’s activation‑loop conformation, allosteric regulation, and MD or experimental dynamics, and correlate those findings with the simulation analyses.
